triggers.name: !pop Server Population

actions.command: say "[POPULATION] Currently {online_players}/{max_players} players online ({queue} in queue) | Server FPS: {fps}"

triggers.description: Displays current online player count, max capacity, queue and server FPS when typing !pop

triggers.name: !discord Community Link

actions.command: say "[DISCORD] Join our official community: https://discord.gg/rust-server"

triggers.description: Sends Discord invite link when player types !discord in chat

triggers.name: !wipe Schedule Info

actions.command: say "[WIPE INFO] Map wipes every Thursday @ 18:00 UTC | Forced wipe first Thursday of month."

triggers.description: Displays next wipe schedule in chat

actions.command: say "[RULES] 1. No Cheating/Scripts 2. Max team size 3 3. English in main chat. Type !discord for support."

triggers.name: Player Join Welcome Greeting

actions.command: say "[SERVER] Welcome {player} to the server! Have fun."

triggers.description: Broadcasts a greeting when a player connects

triggers.name: Cargo Ship Event Alert

actions.command: say "[EVENT] The Cargo Ship is approaching the coast with high-tier loot!"

triggers.description: Alerts all players when Cargo Ship approaches

triggers.name: Auto-Moderation Filter

actions.command: say "[AUTOMOD] Player {player} was muted for 10 minutes for offensive language."

triggers.description: Automatically mutes players who use severe toxic keywords in chat

tasks.name: Auto-Save World
tasks.description: Periodically saves world data and player inventory

tasks.name: Discord Broadcast
tasks.command: say "[ANNOUNCEMENT] Visit our Discord at https://discord.gg/rust-server for events and giveaways!"
tasks.description: Sends periodic community announcements in game chat
